sources.label: 令和8年第1回定例会 議案一覧

name: 田町駅東口・品川駅西口の建築制限を変更
summary: 現在、条例で地区計画の区域内に建てる建築物の制限を定めています。この議案で、都市計画が変更された田町駅東口地区と品川駅西口地区について、地区ごとの建築物の制限を改めます。
changes: 田町駅東口地区の街区ごとに、建築物の用途や壁面の位置などの制限を改める
品川駅西口地区の地区ごとに、建築物の用途や容積率、高さなどの制限を改める
両地区の地区計画の告示番号を改める
who: 田町駅東口地区や品川駅西口地区で建築を行う人や事業者
why: 都市計画が変更された両地区の区域内で、建築物の制限を定めるためと、区長は説明しています。

en.name: Changes building restrictions at Tamachi Station East Exit and Shinagawa Station West Exit
en.official: Ordinance Partially Amending the Ordinance on Building Restrictions within the Areas of Minato City District Plans
en.summary: The ordinance currently sets restrictions on buildings constructed within district plan areas. This bill revises the building restrictions for each district in the Tamachi Station East Exit District and the Shinagawa Station West Exit District, where the urban plans have been changed.
changes: Revises restrictions on building uses, wall positions, and other matters for each block in the Tamachi Station East Exit District
Revises restrictions on building uses, floor area ratios, heights, and other matters for each area in the Shinagawa Station West Exit District
Revises the notification numbers for the district plans in both districts
who: People and businesses carrying out construction in the Tamachi Station East Exit District or the Shinagawa Station West Exit District
en.why: The mayor says the purpose is to set building restrictions within the areas of both districts, where the urban plans have been changed.
